column1: # haseen hardware quirks: id<TAB>match<TAB>summary   (tabs, not spaces)
# The table is the whole dispatcher. A row with a body in
# share/haseen/hardware/<id>.sh is applied once per user and recorded in the
# ledger; a row without one is reported as unimplemented, never skipped in
# silence. Adding a quirk is one file plus one row, and no code change.
# Rows and their match rules are adapted from Omarchy install/hardware/* and
# match: `*` or comma-separated terms that must all hold
#   vendor:RE product:RE family:RE chassis:RE   case-insensitive ERE over DMI
#   probe:NAME    laptop vm nvidia nvidia-gsp nvidia-no-gsp intel-gpu amd-gpu
